item.description:
Beta release — first version with automatic updates.

What's new

  • One place for everything. Big artwork, playback controls and volume for whatever is playing, with a switcher when more than one thing plays.
  • Group speakers. Open Speakers to choose which HomePods play together, each with its own volume.
  • Mini player. A small floating player you can show or hide from the header button or by right-clicking the menu bar icon.
  • Automatic updates. New versions install themselves; check anytime with Check for Updates… in the right-click menu.
